title: Live plugin summon for example.status-panel
description: omarchy plugin add the status panel, omarchy-shell summon example.status-panel, read AT-SPI names Status / Refresh / Close.
acceptance_criteria: Summon through a running omarchy-shell makes Status/Refresh/Close visible to AT-SPI; click-all of those three passes with screenshots.

title: Live SnarkSentinel click-all
description: Summon io.github.mowgli42.snarksentinel, AT-SPI buttons only (same policy as sim/snarksentinel_click.py), PNG screenshot after each click, watch ~/.local/share/snarksentinel/logs + journalctl. Prefer Accessible.name / objectName on Panel.qml buttons in the snarksentinel repo.
acceptance_criteria: Live click-all visits each AT-SPI button once; PNG per step; crash-shaped log fails the run.

title: Input actuator (ydotool / EIS) scoped to nested seat
description: Click and type via ydotool or EIS inside the nested seat only. Do not call xdotool.
acceptance_criteria: Actuator clicks a known AT-SPI button in the nested seat; host seat receives no injected events.

title: AT-SPI connector for widget scrape
description: dogtail or pyatspi against apps that expose a tree. Map roles to button/text/dialog/menu item/link as in docs/standards.md.
acceptance_criteria: Given a GTK (or a11y-enabled) app in the nested seat, derive at least one role=button action from the AT-SPI tree.

title: Nested seat for safe GUI exploration
description: Run the SUT in a nested Hyprland or a systemd seat so ydotool cannot click the host. Reverse the simulator-only choice.
acceptance_criteria: Documented launch script starts a nested seat; explorer docs warn against host-seat clicks; a smoke command proves the nested compositor is up.

title: Production rebuild: live Omarchy seat + report adoption
description: Replace the simulator-only path with a nested-seat explorer that scrapes AT-SPI, clicks via ydotool, oracles crashes, and emits CTRF/JUnit/SARIF. Fixture sims remain the validated demo until each live bead closes.
acceptance_criteria: bd ready shows no open children under this epic for the live seat MVP (nested seat, AT-SPI, actuator, plugin summon, SnarkSentinel click-all, window oracle).

title: CTRF attachments for screenshots and sequence.jsonl
description: Screenshots and sequence.jsonl as CTRF attachments across all simulators (explore, plugin_ui, snarksentinel_click), not loose files only.
acceptance_criteria: Each sim CTRF test entry lists sequence.jsonl and any screenshots under attachments[]; paths resolve under sim/out/.
close_reason: CTRF attachments on explore, plugin_ui, snarksentinel_click via sim/reports.py; sequence.jsonl + screenshots listed and asserted.

title: Add Accessible.name/objectName on SnarkSentinel Panel buttons
description: Work in mowgli42/snarksentinel omarchy-plugin: mark Button controls with Accessible.name matching text and stable objectName so AT-SPI matches the fixture inventory. Not a testar runtime change.
acceptance_criteria: Panel.qml / BarWidget.qml expose Accessible.name for primary buttons; scrape and AT-SPI agree on names.

title: GitHub Actions: JUnit + SARIF upload
description: Upload JUnit XML as the test report and SARIF as code scanning. Fail the job on oracle failure.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs sim explorers; junit and sarif artifacts uploaded; inject-crash job is allowed to fail the step that asserts failure, while clean jobs must pass.
close_reason: .github/workflows/sim.yml runs explorers + replay, uploads JUnit/SARIF/CTRF artifacts; inject-crash must exit non-zero.

title: Window / journal crash oracle
description: hyprctl process exit, window unmapped, journalctl error. Reuse the JSONL crash-log oracle prototyped in sim/snarksentinel_click.py for SnarkSentinel logs.
acceptance_criteria: Killing the SUT mid-walk fails CTRF and writes SARIF oracle/window or oracle/crash-log.

title: Replay failing sequence from sequence.jsonl
description: Reconstruct a failing sequence from sequence.jsonl on the same fixture. Live replay waits on stable widget ids across launches.
acceptance_criteria: python3 sim/replay.py --sequence sim/out/.../sequence.jsonl re-executes the fixture walk and matches pass/fail.
close_reason: sim/replay.py re-executes sequence.jsonl against fixture/snarksentinel app graphs; CI runs both replays.

title: Coverage-biased action policy
description: Replace fixed-seed random with a coverage bias on unvisited roles. snarksentinel_click.py already does name-coverage click-all; generalize for explore.py and live seat.
acceptance_criteria: Shared policy module picks unvisited role=button actions; explore.py and snarksentinel_click.py both use it.

title: Screenshot fallback state source
description: Apps with an empty accessibility tree. Vision or template match. Higher false-action rate. Keep it a separate state source from AT-SPI.
acceptance_criteria: Documented fallback path derives at least one click target from a screenshot when AT-SPI is empty.

title: Playwright state source for Chromium apps
description: Chromium web apps shipped with Omarchy. Same action selector, different scrape (Playwright accessibility snapshot).
acceptance_criteria: One Omarchy web app walk emits sequence.jsonl with role=button actions from a Playwright snapshot.

title: Open Test Reporting export (deferred)
description: Only after a non-JVM consumer exists in the toolchain.
acceptance_criteria: Documented consumer exists; exporter maps CTRF runs to Open Test Reporting events.

title: Cucumber Messages when Gherkin executes
description: When Gherkin scenarios are executed rather than mirrored, emit ndjson messages. Do not grow the legacy Cucumber JSON formatter.
acceptance_criteria: A real Gherkin runner emits Cucumber Messages ndjson for validated scenarios.
